claim: The one-click demo uses sample data that stays separate from real records and can be reset or discarded.
where: landing action, demo banner, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; create a real record; enter ?demo=1; mutate and reset it; start for real; verify the real record

claim: Work Receipt sends no work-session data, analytics, or tracking requests.
where: landing privacy text, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh demo context; record URL, method, and body for every request during an evidence-bearing session and receipt flow; enforce a same-origin GET allowlist

claim: Work Receipt does not track activity or request screen, camera, microphone, or location access.
sandbox: fresh context with capture, location, keyboard, and pointer tracking instrumented; complete manual and timed recording; assert no sensitive API call or global activity listener

claim: Workers can record both timed and completed manual work sessions.
sandbox: fresh context; save a manual session; start a timed session; reload; stop it; assert both complete records

claim: A work session records its outcome, break, optional evidence link, and AI-assisted label.
sandbox: fresh context; save every optional field; assert the log and weekly receipt show the details and deducted break

claim: Workers can edit or delete a saved work session.
sandbox: fresh context; create, edit, and delete one session; assert each state change

claim: Saved work sessions remain in this browser after reload.
sandbox: fresh browser context; create a real work session; reload; assert its full outcome remains

claim: Evidence links are stored as text and open only when selected.
sandbox: fresh context; save an intercepted external evidence URL; assert no request before selection and one request after selecting Open evidence

claim: Receipt identity, client, and closing-note settings are saved and applied to weekly receipts.
sandbox: fresh demo context; edit receipt settings; assert preview values; reload and assert they remain

claim: Clearing this site's browser data removes saved work sessions and receipt settings.
sandbox: fresh context; save a session and settings; clear all origin storage through Chromium; reload; assert both are gone

claim: Saved work sessions open offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh demo context; wait for service-worker control; go offline; reload; assert sample session and offline status

claim: A JSON backup exports and imports all work sessions.
sandbox: fresh context; create two sessions; export and parse JSON; delete both; import the file; assert both return

claim: CSV export contains one row for every work session.
sandbox: fresh demo context; download CSV; assert headers and exactly three sample rows

claim: The weekly PDF lists outcomes, billable time, breaks, and selected evidence.
sandbox: fresh demo context; download the PDF; inspect its file text for the sample outcome, billable duration, excluded break, and evidence label

claim: PDF, JSON, and CSV files are created on the device without uploading work-session data.
sandbox: fresh demo context; download all three formats while recording requests; assert downloads succeed and no POST, request body, or cross-origin request occurs

claim: Work Receipt can be installed as an app in supported browsers.
sandbox: fresh browser context; validate install manifest fields, icons, and an active controlling service worker

claim: Recording, receipt details, weekly PDFs, backup, import, and CSV export are free with no paid tier.
sandbox: fresh context; verify all core controls are enabled and no checkout or license controls exist

claim: Every weekly receipt identifies itself as self-reported rather than independent proof.
where: hero caption, receipt preview, terms page, README
sandbox: fresh demo context; assert the receipt heading and disclaimer in the preview and downloaded PDF
